title: Horizontal launches
target: Find flight time from vertical motion and then horizontal range.
criteria: Find or use fall time before calculating range.
Check units and interpret the landing point.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: A ball leaves a ledge horizontally at 8 m/s. What is its initial vertical velocity?
cpa.guide: A horizontal launch has zero initial vertical component.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A platform is 3.2 m high and launch speed is 6 m/s horizontally. Which values determine fall time in the ideal model?
options: Height, initial vertical velocity, and g.
Horizontal range before it is known.
cpa.guide: Use vertical motion to determine time.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A horizontal launch falls 1.25 m. Use g = 10 m/s² and no drag. What is fall time?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A ball’s horizontal speed is 8 m/s and fall time is 0.75 s. What is range?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A calculated range is 9 m. What does that mean for a horizontal launch?
options: It lands 9 m horizontally from the point directly below the launch.
Its final speed must be 9 m/s.
Its vertical fall must be 9 m.
Its path length must be exactly 9 m.
cpa.guide: Range is horizontal displacement, not height, path length, or speed.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: At fixed height, an ideal horizontal launch speed is reduced to one-third. What happens to range?
options: It becomes one-third; fall time is unchanged.
It becomes one-ninth; fall time triples.
It stays fixed; fall time triples.
cpa.guide: Vertical motion fixes the same time; range scales with horizontal speed.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.
